## What changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue with `Closes #...`
only when this PR fully resolves it.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `npm run verify` (or explain why it was unavailable).
- [ ] Ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Added regression coverage for behavior changes where appropriate.
- [ ] Kept secrets and private prompts/traces out of the patch.

Exact checks and results:

For UI changes, include screenshots, narrow-screen and keyboard checks. For
agent/telemetry changes, describe effects on contracts, spans and events.
State whether live model or SigNoz checks were run and any remaining limits.
